code_snippets.python:
from gradio_client import Client, handle_file

client = Client("gradio/image_mod")
result = client.predict(
	image=handle_file('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gradio-app/gradio/main/test/test_files/bus.png'),
	api_name="/predict",
)
print(result)
code_snippets.bash:
FILE_PATH=$(curl -s -X POST https://gradio-image-mod.hf.space/gradio_api/upload -F 'files=@/path/to/your/file' | tr -d '[]" ')

curl -X POST https://gradio-image-mod.hf.space/gradio_api/call/v2/predict -s -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"image": {"path": "'$FILE_PATH'", "meta": {"_type": "gradio.FileData"}}}' \
  | awk -F'"' '{ print $4}' \
  | read EVENT_ID; curl -N https://gradio-image-mod.hf.space/gradio_api/call/predict/$EVENT_ID
